title: ADCB and ORA Developers UAE enter into a strategic partnership to offer an off-plan financing solution to eligible BAYN customers
summary: An off-plan financing solution for eligible buyers at BAYN, the developers’ flagship masterplan in Ghantoot

contentHtml:
From L-R, Salim Khishen, Executive Head Group Retail Banking, ADCB & Trevor Hardwick, Deputy CEO, ORA Developers. Image Courtesy: ADCB

An off-plan financing solution for eligible buyers at BAYN, the developers’ flagship masterplan in Ghantoot

Press Release

Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) and ORA Developers UAE, have entered into a strategic partnership to offer an off-plan financing solution for eligible buyers at BAYN, the developers’ flagship masterplan in Ghantoot. This serves as the latest milestone by ORA Developers, a global developer and curator of lifestyle destinations, under their strategic partnership with MODON Holding. 

As part of this strategic partnership, eligible buyers at BAYN can access a home financing solution during the construction phase of the project upon completion of the mandatory regulated payment of 50% of the unit value. The solution enables eligible buyers to secure financing for amounts due till handover, supporting greater financing certainty through to handover. 

Customers can benefit from competitive financing rates, pre-approvals valid for up to 12 months, digital onboarding capabilities, and dedicated support through ADCB's specialist Mortgage Centres. Financing applications will be managed directly by ADCB and are subject to the Bank's eligibility criteria, credit assessment, documentation requirements, and applicable terms and conditions.

Naguib Sawiris, Chairman of ORA Developers, said: “As one of the region’s largest private developers, we remain committed to creating active, liveable communities in the UAE and across the Middle East. Our partnership with ADCB is a practical step towards making homeownership more accessible at BAYN. For eligible buyers, the ability to arrange financing during construction for payments due at handover can bring greater clarity and confidence to the purchase journey. As we showcase Y Views at BAYN at LIVEX, this partnership also reflects the confidence that leading financial institutions place in the destination and its long-term vision.” 

Strategically located in Ghantoot between Abu Dhabi and Dubai, BAYN is ORA Developers’ flagship UAE masterplan, reflecting the company’s long-term commitment to the UAE. Spanning 4.8 million sqm, the fully integrated coastal destination is planned to comprise approximately 9,000 homes and is expected to feature 1.2 km of natural beachfront, with more than 55% of the masterplan dedicated to open and landscaped spaces. Construction commenced in June 2026, with the first handovers targeted for Q4 2028.

The Abu Dhabi Real Estate Centre’s H1 2026 Market Report recorded a 289% year-on-year increase in off-plan villa and townhouse sales value. BAYN was among seven key projects that collectively accounted for 65 % of sales value across the segment.

About The ADCB Group

The ADCB Group is one of the UAE’s leading financial institutions, based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

Serving over 2 million customers with a wide range of market-leading products and services, the ADCB Group’s core businesses are Retail Banking, Corporate & Investment Banking, Private Banking and Treasury & Investments.

With a host of award winning digital solutions and market firsts, the ADCB Group is driving digital innovation in the financial services industry, providing the highest levels of service and convenience to its customers and partners.

The ADCB Group operates major subsidiaries including Al Hilal Bank, a digital-first Islamic bank that serves retail customers, and ADCB Egypt, which offers both corporate and retail banking services and ADCB Islamic Bank JSC (ADCB Islamic) in Kazakhstan, which provides corporate and investment banking products and services for corporate clients in Kazakhstan and Central Asia.

The ADCB Group is 60.77% owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi through Mubadala Investment Company through its wholly owned subsidiary One Hundred and Fourteenth Investment Company – Sole Proprietorship LLC and trades on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) under the ticker “ADCB”. 

Further information on the ADCB Group can be found at www.adcb.com

About ORA Developers:

ORA Developers Group is a global real estate leader, known for creating transformative spaces that enhance daily living. Founded in 2016, ORA now holds around $4 billion in consolidated assets and has achieved a proven sales value exceeding $61 billion across Egypt, Greece, Cyprus, Grenada, and Pakistan. Its projects, including Ayia Napa Marina in Cyprus, Eighteen in Pakistan, and 6 strategically located projects in Egypt, exemplify ORA's commitment to integrated communities that blend harmoniously with local culture and landscapes.

With its entry into the UAE, ORA brings a fresh approach aligned with the region’s vision for sustainable urban growth, introducing new standards for thoughtful, community-focused living.
